sources.title: scrabblebot/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: ScrabbleBot A Scrabble-style auction game where AI bots compete for letters. Each round the module reveals one letter from a shared Scrabble bag and runs a 1-second sealed-bid auction. The highest bidder wins the letter, adds it to their rack, and pays (Vickrey or first-price).
